summary: Accept explicit actor attribution for changes sync, missions check, and gate cargo-test

compatibility.detail: Adds optional leading --as to three execution commands. Existing invocations retain their behavior. Sync and mission checks carry explicit identity on the trusted Unix request; cargo-test reports execution attribution on stderr. Explicit actors remain subject to the existing fail-closed agent identity guard.

manual.detail: No upgrade action required. This change requires Agent Policy owner GO before merge; CLI support does not change wrapper policy.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
